test_cases.title: Start of Mission triggers session establishment in Level 2
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. No active communication session exists. RBC contact information is stored.

steps.action: Initiate the Start of Mission procedure.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Trackside order triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. No active communication session exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish a communication session.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Manual level change to Level 2 triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. No active communication session exists.

steps.action: Driver manually changes the level to Level 2.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Engine rear end reaching end of radio hole triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Train is approaching the end of an announced radio hole. No active communication session exists.

steps.action: Move the train so that the engine rear end reaches the end of the announced radio hole.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Driver manual RBC selection outside SoM triggers session establishment
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Not in Start of Mission procedure. No active communication session exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver selects RBC contact information manually.

steps.action: Driver manually selects RBC contact information.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the process to establish a communication session with the RBC.

test_cases.title: Session establishment sequence with successful connection
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to establish a session. Trackside is available.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests the set-up of a safe radio connection.

steps.action: Safe radio connection is established.
steps.expected: OBU sends the 'Initiation of communication session' message.

steps.action: Trackside sends the system version.
steps.expected: OBU considers the session established and sends a 'Session established report'.

test_cases.title: Session establishment with incompatible system version
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is ready to establish a session. Trackside sends an incompatible system version.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment and allow safe radio connection to be set up.
steps.expected: OBU sends 'Initiation of communication session'.

steps.action: Trackside sends an incompatible system version.
steps.expected: OBU sends 'No compatible version supported', informs the driver, and terminates the session.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on trackside order (FRMCS-only RBC)
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Trackside order specifies an RBC interfaced with FRMCS only.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to establish session with FRMCS-only RBC.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with FRMCS-only RBC.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using the FRMCS radio system.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on driver's single-radio choice
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. Driver elected to use only GSM-R during SoM.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment (e.g., via trackside order not specifying FRMCS-only).
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using the GSM-R radio system.

test_cases.title: Radio system selection based on stored preferred radio system
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. No trackside order specifying FRMCS-only. No driver single-radio choice. Previous session used FRMCS.

steps.action: Trigger session establishment.
steps.expected: OBU requests safe radio connection set-up using the FRMCS radio system (preferred from previous session).

test_cases.title: Memorisation of successful radio system
test_cases.preconditions: Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed. Session establishment is triggered.

steps.action: Establish a communication session using GSM-R.
steps.expected: OBU stores GSM-R as the radio system used for the successful safe radio connection set-up.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to End of Mission
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection requested, not yet established).

steps.action: Perform End of Mission while session establishment is ongoing.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection if any.

test_cases.title: Abort session establishment due to trackside termination order
test_cases.preconditions: Session establishment is in progress (safe radio connection established, waiting for system version).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to terminate communication session.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: OBU aborts the session establishment process and releases the safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Contact last known RBC using stored info
test_cases.preconditions: RBC contact information is stored on-board. Trackside sends order with special RBC identity value for 'last known RBC' and a different phone number.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order with special RBC identity value.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with last known RBC.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the phone number in the order and uses the stored RBC contact information to establish the session.

test_cases.title: Ignore order for last known RBC when no info stored
test_cases.preconditions: No RBC contact information is stored on-board. Trackside sends order with special RBC identity value for 'last known RBC'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order with special RBC identity value.

steps.action: Receive trackside order to establish session with last known RBC.
steps.expected: OBU ignores the order and does not attempt to establish a communication session.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with same RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is currently being established (setup in progress).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., driver selects Start or receives order).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is capable of detecting the state of the ongoing session.

steps.action: Initiate a request to establish a communication session with RBC-A while the initial session setup with RBC-A is still in progress.
steps.expected: The OBU does not initiate a new, separate session establishment process with RBC-A. The existing setup process continues or is handled according to standard abort/retry logic, but no parallel session is opened.

test_cases.title: Prevention of duplicate session establishment with active RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with RBC-A is established and active. No Termination of Communication Session message has been sent to RBC-A.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger for a new session with RBC-A (e.g., manual selection of RBC contact info).

steps.action: Trigger a new session establishment request for RBC-A (e.g., via manual selection or mode change) while the session with RBC-A is active.
steps.expected: The OBU does not open a further communication session with RBC-A. The existing session remains the only active session with that RBC.

test_cases.title: Termination of existing session when establishing new one with different RBC
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and has an active communication session with RBC-A. OBU is capable of handling only one GSM-R session.
test_cases.test_inputs: Order to establish session with RBC-B.
test_cases.assumptions: RBC-A and RBC-B are different entities.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to establish a communication session with RBC-B.
steps.expected: The OBU initiates the termination of the existing session with RBC-A.

steps.action: Wait for the termination of the session with RBC-A to complete.
steps.expected: The OBU establishes a new communication session with RBC-B.

test_cases.title: Exception: RBC transition order does not terminate supervising RBC session
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2 and has an active communication session with RBC-A (Supervising RBC). OBU is capable of handling multiple sessions or the specific exception applies.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transition order containing an order to establish session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU supports the RBC transition procedure where the supervising RBC session is maintained during the handover.

steps.action: Receive an RBC transition order that includes an order to establish a session with RBC-B (Accepting RBC).
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT terminate the existing session with RBC-A (Supervising RBC). It proceeds to establish the session with RBC-B while keeping the session with RBC-A active.

test_cases.title: Evaluation of information direction in SL/PS/SH modes
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Sleeping (SL) mode. Train orientation is Forward. A balise group is crossed in the Reverse direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Information from the crossed balise group valid for Reverse direction.
test_cases.assumptions: The balise group crossing direction is detectable by the OBU.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the Reverse direction while in SL mode. The balise transmits information valid for the Reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU takes the information into account, as it matches the crossing direction, despite the train orientation being Forward.

test_cases.title: Ignoring information valid for opposite direction in SL/PS/SH modes
test_cases.preconditions: Engine is in Passive Shunting (PS) mode. Train orientation is Forward. A balise group is crossed in the Forward direction.
test_cases.test_inputs: Information from the crossed balise group valid for Reverse direction only.

steps.action: Cross a balise group in the Forward direction while in PS mode. The balise transmits information valid only for the Reverse direction.
steps.expected: The OBU ignores the information, as it is valid for the opposite direction to the crossing direction.

test_cases.title: Persistence of MA request parameters
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters (repetition period T1) have been received from RBC. An MA request was sent at time t0.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time elapsed since last MA request is less than T1.
test_cases.assumptions: No new MA request parameters are received.

steps.action: Wait for a time interval less than the repetition period T1 since the last MA request.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to use the previously received parameters. No new MA request is triggered solely due to time if the triggering criteria (e.g., perturbation) are not met, or if the repetition logic hasn't reached the interval.

test_cases.title: Immediate MA request upon receiving new parameters if interval exceeded
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. Last MA request was sent at time t0. Current time is t1 such that (t1 - t0) >= New Repetition Period T2.
test_cases.test_inputs: New MA request parameters with repetition period T2.

steps.action: Receive new MA request parameters from the RBC with a repetition period T2.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately sends an MA request to the RBC, because the time since the last request is equal to or higher than the newly received repetition period.

test_cases.title: No SvL defined while supervising LOA
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is supervising a Limit of Authority (LOA) with a target speed above zero. There are potential SvL candidates (e.g., end of overlap) within the LOA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves within the LOA.

steps.action: Monitor the OBU's internal state for Supervised Location (SvL) definition while the train is within the LOA.
steps.expected: The OBU does not define any Supervised Location (SvL) on board. The end of overlap, Danger Point, or end of End Section are not used as SvL.

test_cases.title: Validity of Level 1 signalling speed restriction until new one received
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1. A signalling related speed restriction (e.g., 80 km/h) has been received and is active.
test_cases.test_inputs: No new signalling related speed restriction received.

steps.action: Allow the train to travel for a period without receiving a new signalling related speed restriction.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to apply the previously received speed restriction (80 km/h).

test_cases.title: Level 1 to Level 2 transition: Signalling speed restriction remains valid
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 1 with an active signalling related speed restriction (e.g., 60 km/h).
test_cases.test_inputs: Transition to Level 2. No Level 2 MA accepted yet.

steps.action: Switch the OBU from Level 1 to Level 2.
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction (60 km/h) remains valid and is applied by the OBU.

steps.action: Accept a Level 2 Movement Authority (MA).
steps.expected: The signalling related speed restriction is no longer the primary constraint if the Level 2 MA provides a different/valid speed profile, or it is replaced according to Level 2 rules. The key check is that it was valid *until* this point.

test_cases.title: Maximum Train Speed as Static Speed Restriction
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with a specific Maximum Train Speed (e.g., 200 km/h) based on train performance.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed approaches 200 km/h.
test_cases.assumptions: No other speed restrictions (TSR, signalling) are lower than 200 km/h.

steps.action: Accelerate the train towards the configured Maximum Train Speed.
steps.expected: The OBU treats the Maximum Train Speed as a Static Speed Restriction. The train speed is limited to this value, and braking curves are calculated accordingly if the limit is approached.

test_cases.title: Initial state: No speed restriction for permitted braking distance
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a state where no speed restrictions for permitted braking distance have been computed from trackside data (initial state).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train is moving.

steps.action: Observe the OBU's speed supervision logic before any trackside data for permitted braking distance is received.
steps.expected: The OBU uses 'no speed restriction' as the initial state. No permitted-braking-distance limit constrains the train speed.

test_cases.title: Resumption of initial state upon trackside order
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is currently applying a speed restriction for permitted braking distance based on trackside data.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside order to resume initial state.

steps.action: Receive an order from trackside to resume the initial state for speed restrictions.
steps.expected: The OBU removes the permitted-braking-distance limit. The train speed is no longer constrained by this specific restriction.

test_cases.title: Immediate reconnection attempt after safe radio connection loss
test_cases.preconditions: An established communication session exists with the RBC. The safe radio connection is active. The radio system used for the connection is identified (e.g., GSM-R or FRMCS).
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated loss of safe radio connection signal from EURORADIO.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU is configured to use the previously successful radio system for reconnection.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection via EURORADIO indication.
steps.expected: The OBU immediately initiates a request to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Verify the radio system used for the reconnection attempt.
steps.expected: The reconnection attempt is made using the same radio system through which the safe radio connection was previously established.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when new connection is established
test_cases.preconditions: The safe radio connection is lost during an established communication session. The OBU is in the process of attempting to re-establish the connection.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated successful establishment of a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the successful establishment of a new safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when session is terminated
test_cases.preconditions: The safe radio connection is lost during an established communication session. The OBU is in the process of attempting to re-establish the connection.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated termination of the communication session (e.g., via timeout or explicit termination order).
test_cases.assumptions: The session termination condition is met according to the defined time or explicit command.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the termination of the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts stop when train passes RIU termination location
test_cases.preconditions: The safe radio connection is lost during an established communication session with an RIU. An RIU order to terminate the communication session at a specific location is active. The OBU is in the process of attempting to re-establish the connection.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated train movement passing the location indicated in the RIU order.
test_cases.assumptions: The train position is accurately tracked by the OBU.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate the train passing the location indicated in the RIU order to terminate the communication session.
steps.expected: The OBU stops repeating the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: Reconnection attempts continue while conditions are not met
test_cases.preconditions: The safe radio connection is lost during an established communication session. The OBU is in the process of attempting to re-establish the connection.
test_cases.test_inputs: Simulated repeated failures of reconnection attempts without meeting termination conditions.
test_cases.assumptions: The defined time for session termination has not expired, and the train has not passed the RIU termination location.

steps.action: Simulate the loss of the safe radio connection.
steps.expected: The OBU starts repeating attempts to set up a new safe radio connection.

steps.action: Simulate multiple failed reconnection attempts.
steps.expected: The OBU continues to repeat the reconnection attempts.

test_cases.title: OBU başlatır: RBC'den gelen komut üzerine oturum sonlandırma
test_cases.preconditions: Aktif bir iletişim oturumu kurulmuştur. RBC, oturum sonlandırma komutu göndermeye hazırdır.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen 'Termination of communication session' komutu.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen oturum sonlandırma komutu OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajını RBC'ye gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen onay (acknowledgement) OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumunun sonlandığını kabul eder ve güvenli radyo bağlantısının serbest bırakılmasını ister.

test_cases.title: OBU başlatır: RBC komutu olmadan sonlandırma koşulu oluştuğunda
test_cases.preconditions: Aktif bir iletişim oturumu kurulmuştur. SUBSET-026'da tanımlanan bir sonlandırma koşulu (örneğin, sürücü tarafından seviye değişikliği veya görev sonu bildirimi) tetiklenmiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Sonlandırma koşulunu tetikleyen olay (örneğin, sürücü tarafından 'End of Mission' seçimi).
test_cases.assumptions: RBC'den açık bir sonlandırma komutu gelmemiştir.

steps.action: Sürücü tarafından sonlandırma koşulunu gerektiren işlem (örneğin, görev sonu bildirimi) yapılır.
steps.expected: OBU, RBC'den açık bir komut olmasa bile 'Termination of communication session' mesajını gönderir.

steps.action: RBC'den gelen onay (acknowledgement) OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumunun sonlandığını kabul eder.

test_cases.title: OBU başlatmaz: Geçersiz koşul veya komut yoksa
test_cases.preconditions: Aktif bir iletişim oturumu kurulmuştur. Hiçbir sonlandırma koşulu oluşmamıştır ve RBC'den komut gelmemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Hiçbir girdi (komut veya koşul tetikleyicisi).

steps.action: Sistem belirli bir süre boyunca izlenir, ancak sonlandırma komutu veya koşulu tetiklenmez.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajı göndermez. Oturum aktif kalır.

test_cases.title: Onay gelmediğinde mesajın tekrarlanması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajını göndermiştir. RBC'den onay beklenmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den onay mesajı (acknowledgement) gönderilmez.
test_cases.assumptions: Appendix A.3.1'de tanımlı sabit bekleme süresi (T_wait) ve tekrar sayısı (N_max) test ortamında yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajını ilk kez gönderir.
steps.expected: Mesaj gönderilir. OBU, T_wait süresi boyunca onay bekler.

steps.action: T_wait süresi dolmadan RBC'den onay gelmez.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajını ikinci kez gönderir.

steps.action: İkinci gönderimden sonra T_wait süresi dolmadan RBC'den onay gelmez.
steps.expected: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajını üçüncü kez gönderir (N_max'a ulaşana kadar devam eder).

test_cases.title: Tanımlı tekrar sayısına ulaşıldığında oturumun sonlandırılması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajını N_max-1 kez tekrarlamıştır. RBC'den hâlâ onay gelmemiştir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den onay mesajı (acknowledgement) gönderilmez.
test_cases.assumptions: Appendix A.3.1'de tanımlı sabit bekleme süresi (T_wait) ve tekrar sayısı (N_max) test ortamında yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajını N_max'inci (son) kez gönderir.
steps.expected: Mesaj gönderilir. OBU, T_wait süresi boyunca onay bekler.

steps.action: T_wait süresi dolmadan RBC'den onay gelmez.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumunun sonlandığını kabul eder. Ek bir mesaj göndermez. Güvenli radyo bağlantısının serbest bırakılmasını ister.

test_cases.title: Onay zamanında gelirse tekrarın durdurulması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajını ilk kez göndermiştir. RBC'den onay beklenmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den onay mesajı (acknowledgement) T_wait süresi içinde gönderilir.
test_cases.assumptions: Appendix A.3.1'de tanımlı sabit bekleme süresi (T_wait) test ortamında yapılandırılmıştır.

steps.action: OBU, 'Termination of communication session' mesajını ilk kez gönderir.
steps.expected: Mesaj gönderilir.

steps.action: T_wait süresi dolmadan RBC'den onay (acknowledgement) OBU'ya iletilir.
steps.expected: OBU, iletişim oturumunun sonlandığını kabul eder. Ek bir tekrar mesajı göndermez.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered at power-up
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected and powered on. The OBU has a memorised GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a registration order to the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal for the memorised GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered after driver enters new identity
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on and in a state where the driver can enter a GSM-R Radio Network identity. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected.
test_cases.test_inputs: A valid new GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: The driver enters a new GSM-R Radio Network identity into the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a registration order to the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal for the newly entered GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: GSM-R registration ordered by trackside
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected. The OBU is currently registered to a different GSM-R Radio Network or not registered.
test_cases.test_inputs: A Radio Network transition order from trackside containing a GSM-R Radio Network identity.

steps.action: The OBU receives a Radio Network transition order from trackside specifying a GSM-R Radio Network identity.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a registration order to the connected GSM-R Mobile Terminal for the specified GSM-R Radio Network.

test_cases.title: Default Radio Network type used when no memorised type exists
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered off. The OBU's non-volatile memory has been cleared or is in a state where no Radio Network type is memorised (simulating first power-up or system failure recovery).
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU has a default Radio Network type configured in its on-board configuration.

steps.action: Power on the OBU.
steps.expected: The OBU uses the default Radio Network type configured on-board for its operations.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Only FRMCS is installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS. The FRMCS on-board equipment is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when FRMCS not registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, driver elected FRMCS only)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has elected to perform the mission with FRMCS only. The FRMCS on-board equipment is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when no radio system registered (FRMCS+GSM-R, both installed, no single-radio election)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Both FRMCS and GSM-R are installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is FRMCS+GSM-R. The driver has NOT elected to perform the mission with only one radio system. The FRMCS on-board equipment is NOT registered to the FRMCS Radio Network. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request when GSM-R not registered (GSM-R only installed)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. Only GSM-R is installed on-board. The stored Radio Network type is GSM-R. No GSM-R Mobile Terminal is registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RBC.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RBC.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: No safe radio connection request for RIU when GSM-R not registered
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is powered on. A GSM-R Mobile Terminal is connected but NOT registered to a GSM-R Radio Network.
test_cases.test_inputs: An order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RIU.

steps.action: The OBU receives an order from trackside to establish a communication session with an RIU.
steps.expected: The OBU does NOT request the set-up of a safe radio connection.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurulduğunda gösterimin 'Connection Up' olması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma sürecinde ve 'No Connection' durumundadır.

steps.action: OBU'nun ilgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısını başarıyla kurması sağlanır (Koşul [4]).
steps.expected: Sürücüye gösterilen durum 'Connection Up' olarak değişir.

test_cases.title: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kaybolduğunda ve zamanlayıcı süresi dolduğunda gösterimin 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olması
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, ilgili RBC/RIU ile 'Connection Up' durumundadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Bağlantı durumu zamanlayıcısının (connection status timer) süresi test ortamında gözlemlenebilir veya hızlandırılabilir.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısının kaybolduğu simüle edilir (Koşul [6] veya [2] için ön adım).
steps.expected: OBU, bağlantıyı yeniden kurmak için istekler göndermeye başlar ve 'connection status' zamanlayıcısı çalışır durumda olur. Gösterim henüz 'Connection Up' olarak kalabilir veya geçiş tablosuna göre değişir, ancak hata durumu hemen tetiklenmez.

steps.action: Bağlantı yeniden kurulamazsa 'connection status' zamanlayıcısının süresinin dolması beklenir (Koşul [2]).
steps.expected: Gösterim durumu 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak değişir.

test_cases.title: Bağlantı kurma istekleri durdurulduğunda zamanlayıcının durdurulması ve durumun 'No Connection' olması

steps.action: İlgili RBC/RIU ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma isteklerinin durdurulması sağlanır (örneğin, görev sonu veya sürücü müdahalesi ile) (Koşul [3] veya [6] için 'isteklerin durdurulması' kısmı).
steps.expected: Eğer 'connection status' zamanlayıcısı çalışıyorsa durdurulur. Gösterim durumu 'No Connection' olarak değişir.

test_cases.title: Görev başlatma sırasında bağlantı kurma başarısız olduğunda 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' gösterimi
test_cases.preconditions: Görev başlatma (Start of Mission) prosedürü devam etmektedir ve OBU 'No Connection' durumundadır.

steps.action: Güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurma için son denemenin başarısız olması sağlanır (Koşul [1]).
steps.expected: Gösterim durumu 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak değişir.

test_cases.title: Radyo deliği (radio hole) ile çakışmada 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' gösterimi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, 'Connection Up' durumundadır ve tren, duyurulmuş bir radyo deliğine (announced radio hole) yaklaşıyor veya içindedir.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin ön ve arka güvenli uçlarının (safe front/rear end) konumu test ortamında kontrol edilebilir.

steps.expected: Gösterim durumu 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak değişir.

test_cases.title: Birden fazla RIU ile bağlantı durumunda geçerli infill alanına ait durumun gösterilmesi
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, birden fazla Radio Infill Unit (RIU) ile güvenli radyo bağlantısı kurmuştur. Tren, RIU-A'nın infill alanındadır.
test_cases.assumptions: RIU-A ve RIU-B olarak adlandırılan iki farklı RIU ile bağlantı kurulabilir.

steps.action: RIU-A ile bağlantı 'Connection Up' iken, RIU-B ile bağlantının 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' durumuna geçmesi sağlanır.
steps.expected: Sürücüye gösterilen durum, geçerli infill alanı olan RIU-A'ya ait durum olan 'Connection Up' olarak kalır.

steps.action: Trenin RIU-B'nin infill alanına girmesi sağlanır (geçerli infill alanı RIU-B olur).
steps.expected: Sürücüye gösterilen durum, artık geçerli infill alanı olan RIU-B'ye ait durum olan 'Connection Lost/Set-Up failed' olarak değişir.

test_cases.title: Acceptance of trackside info referring to 8th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has reported 8 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups (LRBG1 to LRBG8) to the RBC in sequence. LRBG1 is the oldest, LRBG8 is the most recent. The RBC sends a message (e.g., Movement Authority) referring to LRBG1.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message references LRBG1.
test_cases.assumptions: LRBG1 is within the 'at least eight' window defined in §3.6.2.2.2 c).

steps.action: The OBU receives the RBC message referring to LRBG1.
steps.expected: The OBU accepts the message and processes the location data relative to LRBG1.

test_cases.title: Rejection of trackside info referring to 9th last reported LRBG
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has reported 9 distinct LRBG compliant balise groups (LRBG1 to LRBG9) to the RBC in sequence. LRBG1 is the oldest, LRBG9 is the most recent. The RBC sends a message referring to LRBG1.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC message references LRBG1.
test_cases.assumptions: The requirement specifies 'at least eight'. If the implementation strictly limits the buffer to 8, LRBG1 (the 9th last) should be outside the valid reference window for acceptance if the buffer has shifted. However, the requirement says 'accept information referring to one of at least eight LRBGONB last reported'. This implies the buffer size is >= 8. To test the boundary, we assume the implementation uses exactly 8. If the buffer holds the last 8 (LRBG2 to LRBG9), LRBG1 is no longer in the buffer.

steps.action: The OBU receives the RBC message referring to LRBG1 (which is the 9th last reported LRBG).
steps.expected: The OBU rejects the message or flags it as invalid because LRBG1 is no longer in the list of the last 8 reported LRBGs (assuming a fixed window of 8).

test_cases.title: Position report on RBC/RBC border crossing (min safe rear end)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. The train is approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Move the train such that its minimum safe rear end passes the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Position report on RBC/RBC border crossing (max safe front end)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in a mode where position reporting is active. The train is approaching an RBC/RBC border.

steps.action: Move the train such that its maximum safe front end passes the RBC/RBC border.
steps.expected: The OBU sends a position report to the RBC.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status: No integrity information
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has just established a communication session with the RBC. No train integrity confirmation has been received or given yet.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by reaching standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'No train integrity information'.

steps.action: Inspect the confirmed train length field in the report.
steps.expected: The confirmed train length information is not present or is marked as unavailable, as integrity is not confirmed.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status: Confirmed by driver
test_cases.preconditions: Train is at standstill. Valid Train Data is available and acknowledged by RBC. OBU is in a state where driver can confirm integrity.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity via the HMI.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal train integrity status to 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report (e.g., by leaving standstill).
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Train integrity confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Inspect the confirmed train length field in the report.
steps.expected: The confirmed train length information is present and represents the distance between the min safe rear end at the time of last known integer state and the current estimated front end position.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status: Confirmed by external source
test_cases.preconditions: Valid Train Data is available. OBU is in a state where it can receive external integrity confirmation.

steps.action: Simulate receipt of 'Train integrity confirmed' information from an external source (e.g., via Train Interface).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal train integrity status to 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Train integrity confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Inspect the confirmed train length field in the report.
steps.expected: The confirmed train length information is present and calculated correctly.

test_cases.title: Train integrity status: Lost
test_cases.preconditions: Train integrity is currently confirmed (by driver or external source).

steps.action: Simulate detection of train integrity loss (e.g., via external source or internal fault).
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal train integrity status to 'Train integrity lost'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The position report contains the train integrity status 'Train integrity lost'.

steps.action: Inspect the confirmed train length field in the report.
steps.expected: The confirmed train length information is not present or is marked as unavailable, as integrity is lost.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Integrity to Confirmed by Driver
test_cases.preconditions: Train is at standstill. Valid Train Data is available and acknowledged by RBC. Current status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Driver confirms train integrity.
steps.expected: The OBU transitions the train integrity status from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by driver'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the new status 'Confirmed by driver'.

test_cases.title: Transition from No Integrity to Confirmed by External Source
test_cases.preconditions: Valid Train Data is available. Current status is 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Simulate receipt of 'Train integrity confirmed' from an external source.
steps.expected: The OBU transitions the train integrity status from 'No integrity information' to 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the new status 'Confirmed by external source'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Confirmed to Lost (External Source)
test_cases.preconditions: Current status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source'. Valid Train Data is available.

steps.action: Simulate receipt of 'Train integrity lost' from an external source.
steps.expected: The OBU transitions the train integrity status to 'Train integrity lost'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the new status 'Train integrity lost'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Confirmed to No Integrity (Train Data Invalid)
test_cases.preconditions: Current status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source'.

steps.action: Change the Train Data status from valid to invalid.
steps.expected: The OBU transitions the train integrity status to 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the new status 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Confirmed to No Integrity (Reverse Movement)
test_cases.preconditions: Current status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source'. Train is moving forward.

steps.action: Perform a reverse movement (change train orientation to reverse).
steps.expected: The OBU transitions the train integrity status to 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the new status 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Transition from Confirmed to No Integrity (Position Exceeds Confirmed Length)
test_cases.preconditions: Current status is 'Confirmed by driver' or 'Confirmed by external source'. Train is moving.

steps.action: Move the train such that the distance between the min safe rear end at the time of last known integer state and the current estimated position exceeds the range of the confirmed train length information.
steps.expected: The OBU transitions the train integrity status to 'No integrity information'.

steps.action: Trigger a position report.
steps.expected: The report reflects the new status 'No integrity information'.

test_cases.title: Geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has valid geographical position information stored and the display is currently off.

steps.action: Verify that the geographical position is not displayed on the DMI.
steps.expected: The geographical position is not visible on the display.

steps.action: The driver requests the display of the geographical position using the defined interface (e.g., touch or soft key).
steps.expected: The OBU displays the geographical position of the estimated front end in relation to the track kilometre.

test_cases.title: Stop geographical position display on driver request
test_cases.preconditions: The geographical position is currently displayed on the DMI.

steps.action: The driver requests to stop the display of the geographical position using the defined interface.
steps.expected: The OBU stops displaying the geographical position.

steps.action: Wait for a short period to ensure the display does not reappear automatically.
steps.expected: The geographical position remains hidden.

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation includes distance travelled
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has detected a geographical reference balise group and the track kilometre reference is applicable. The train is moving in the direction of increasing track kilometre.
test_cases.assumptions: The offset from the reference balise group to the track kilometre reference is known and set to 0m for simplicity. The initial distance travelled is 0m.

steps.action: Record the initial displayed geographical position immediately after the reference becomes applicable.
steps.expected: The displayed position corresponds to the track kilometre reference value (e.g., 1000m).

steps.action: Move the train forward by a known distance (e.g., 50m) using the test track or simulation.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the new geographical position by adding the 50m distance travelled to the reference value.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position.
steps.expected: The displayed position is 1050m (1000m reference + 50m travelled).

test_cases.title: Geographical position calculation with non-zero offset
test_cases.preconditions: The OBU has detected a geographical reference balise group. The offset from the reference balise group to the track kilometre reference is 100m. The train is moving in the direction of increasing track kilometre.
test_cases.assumptions: The track kilometre reference value is 2000m. The initial distance travelled from the balise group is 0m.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position immediately after the reference becomes applicable.
steps.expected: The displayed position is 2100m (2000m reference + 100m offset + 0m travelled).

steps.action: Move the train forward by 20m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the internal position calculation.

steps.action: Request the display of the geographical position again.
steps.expected: The displayed position is 2120m (2000m reference + 100m offset + 20m travelled).

test_cases.title: Roll-away distance supervision start and remaining distance calculation
test_cases.preconditions: The train is stationary. The Roll Away Protection function is active. The National Value for roll-away distance is set to 10 m. The odometer is calibrated with zero error.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward 5 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The 'location' for supervision start is the current train position at the moment the function is activated.

steps.action: Activate the Roll Away Protection supervision.
steps.expected: The OBU calculates the remaining distance to be 10 m (Supervised Distance 10 m - Distance Travelled 0 m).

steps.action: Move the train forward by 5 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 5 m (10 m - 5 m).

test_cases.title: Post Trip reversing distance supervision start
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Post Trip mode. The National Value for maximum reversing distance is 50 m. The train is stationary at the start of the reversing area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train reverses 20 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The supervision starts when the reversing movement is initiated or when the specific Post Trip reversing supervision is triggered.

steps.action: Initiate reversing movement in Post Trip mode.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervision of the reversing distance. The remaining distance is calculated as 50 m.

steps.action: Move the train in reverse direction by 20 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 30 m (50 m - 20 m).

test_cases.title: Trip suppression distance supervision after Override
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Standstill mode. The Override function is available. The National Value for trip suppression distance is 100 m. The train is stationary.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward 40 m after Override.
test_cases.assumptions: The supervision for trip suppression distance starts when the Override function is triggered.

steps.action: Trigger the Override function.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervision of the trip suppression distance. The remaining distance is 100 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 40 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distance to 60 m (100 m - 40 m).

test_cases.title: Staff Responsible distance supervision with virtual train position
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Staff Responsible (SR) mode. The SR distance is determined by a National Value of 200 m. The odometer has a known under-reading of 2 m and over-reading of 2 m since supervision start. The train is stationary at the start of SR supervision.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward 50 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The virtual train position is created at the start of SR supervision. The 'estimated' position is the raw odometer reading. The 'min safe' position is estimated + over-reading. The 'max safe' position is estimated - under-reading.

steps.action: Enter Staff Responsible mode with a National Value distance of 200 m.
steps.expected: The OBU creates a virtual train position. The remaining distance from the estimated front end is 200 m. The remaining distance from the max safe front end is 200 m - 2 m = 198 m. The remaining distance from the min safe front end is 200 m + 2 m = 202 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 50 m.
steps.expected: The OBU updates the remaining distances. Estimated: 200 m - 50 m = 150 m. Max safe: 198 m - 50 m = 148 m. Min safe: 202 m - 50 m = 152 m.

test_cases.title: Zero distance supervision to former EOA/LOA after Override without valid position
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Standstill mode. There is no valid train position stored on-board (e.g., after a power loss without balise reading). The Override function is triggered. The former EOA/LOA is at the current train position (distance 0).
test_cases.test_inputs: Train moves forward 1 m.
test_cases.assumptions: The supervision of the zero distance to the former EOA/LOA starts when Override is triggered without a valid position. The virtual train position is set to the current location.

steps.action: Trigger Override function without a valid stored train position.
steps.expected: The OBU starts supervision of the zero distance to the former EOA/LOA. The remaining distance is 0 m.

steps.action: Move the train forward by 1 m.
steps.expected: The OBU detects that the train has passed the former EOA/LOA (distance travelled > 0). The remaining distance becomes negative, triggering the trip condition or end of Override procedure as per 5.8.4.1 c).

test_cases.title: Re-start of SR distance supervision upon RBC update
test_cases.preconditions: The train is in Staff Responsible mode. The initial SR distance is 100 m. The train has moved 20 m. The RBC transmits a new SR distance of 150 m.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC transmits new SR distance 150 m.
test_cases.assumptions: According to 3.6.7.5, an update of the SR distance via RBC is considered a re-start of supervision. The previous virtual train position is deleted and a new one is created at the current location.

steps.action: Receive a new SR distance of 150 m from the RBC while in SR mode.
steps.expected: The OBU deletes the previous virtual train position. A new virtual train position is created at the current train location. The remaining distance is reset to 150 m (based on the new supervised distance and the new start location).

test_cases.title: MA reddedilmesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de Full Supervision modunda çalışmaktadır. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri yüklüdür.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir MA mesajı (Non-infill). SSP/gradient verisi, trenin tahmini ön ucundan (estimated front end) yeni MA'nın denetlenen konumuna (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi kapsamayacak şekilde kısa tutulmuştur.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön ucu (estimated front end) ve yeni MA'nın denetlenen konumu (supervised location) arasındaki mesafe, mevcut SSP/gradient verisinin bitiş noktasından uzaktır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve gradient verisinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamadığı yeni bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mode profile geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı ve log kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA reddedildiğine dair bir hata durumu veya log kaydı gözlemlenir. Hız profili ve denetim sınırları değişmemiştir.

test_cases.title: MA reddedilmesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de Full Supervision modunda çalışmaktadır. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri yüklüdür.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir MA mesajı (Infill). SSP/gradient verisi, infill konum referans noktasından (infill location reference) yeni MA'nın denetlenen konumuna (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi kapsamayacak şekilde kısa tutulmuştur.
test_cases.assumptions: Infill konum referans noktası ile yeni MA'nın denetlenen konumu arasındaki mesafe, mevcut SSP/gradient verisinin bitiş noktasından uzaktır.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve gradient verisinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (infill konum referansından denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamadığı yeni bir infill MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mode profile geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı ve log kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA reddedildiğine dair bir hata durumu veya log kaydı gözlemlenir. Hız profili ve denetim sınırları değişmemiştir.

test_cases.title: MA reddedilmesi: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsamıyor (Supervised Manoeuvre, ters yön)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de çalışmaktadır. Supervised Manoeuvre (SM) yetkisi beklenmektedir.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir MA mesajı (Supervised Manoeuvre parçası). Geçerlilik yönü, mevcut tren yönünün tersinedir. SSP/gradient verisi, yeni tren yönüne göre tahmini tren ön ucundan (estimated front end derived from new train orientation) denetlenen konuma kadar olan mesafeyi kapsamayacak şekilde kısa tutulmuştur.
test_cases.assumptions: Yeni tren yönüne göre tahmini tren ön ucu ile denetlenen konum arasındaki mesafe, mevcut SSP/gradient verisinin bitiş noktasından uzaktır.

steps.action: RBC'den, geçerlilik yönü mevcut tren yönünün tersi olan ve SSP/gradient verisinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (yeni yöne göre tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsamadığı bir SM MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) reddeder. Mevcut MA ve mode profile geçerli kalmaya devam eder.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı ve log kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: MA reddedildiğine dair bir hata durumu veya log kaydı gözlemlenir. Hız profili ve denetim sınırları değişmemiştir.

test_cases.title: MA kabulü: SSP/gradient MA uzunluğunu tam kapsıyor (Non-infill)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU, Level 2'de Full Supervision modunda çalışmaktadır. Mevcut MA ve SSP/gradient verileri yüklüdür.
test_cases.test_inputs: Yeni bir MA mesajı (Non-infill). SSP/gradient verisi, trenin tahmini ön ucundan (estimated front end) yeni MA'nın denetlenen konumuna (supervised location) kadar olan mesafeyi tam olarak kapsamaktadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön ucu ve yeni MA'nın denetlenen konumu arasındaki mesafe, mevcut SSP/gradient verisinin bitiş noktasından kısa veya eşittir.

steps.action: RBC'den, SSP ve gradient verisinin MA'nın tam uzunluğunu (tahmini tren ön ucundan denetlenen konuma kadar) kapsadığı yeni bir MA mesajı gönderilir.
steps.expected: OBU, yeni MA'yı ve ilişkili mode profile'ı (varsa) kabul eder. Yeni MA geçerli hale gelir.

steps.action: OBU'nun durum ekranı ve log kayıtları incelenir.
steps.expected: Yeni MA'nın kabul edildiğine dair bir durum veya log kaydı gözlemlenir. Hız profili yeni MA'ya göre güncellenmiştir.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Static Speed Profile from start location
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Stored Static Speed Profile (SSP) exists covering the current MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: New SSP message with a start location within the current MA.

steps.action: Inject a new Static Speed Profile message where the start location is ahead of the current train position.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces the stored SSP from the new start location onwards. The SSP data before the new start location remains unchanged.

steps.action: Verify the stored SSP data after the new start location.
steps.expected: The stored SSP matches the new message content from the start location to the end of the MA.

test_cases.title: Complete replacement of Route Suitability Loading Gauge
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Route Suitability Loading Gauge information.
test_cases.test_inputs: New Route Suitability Loading Gauge message.

steps.action: Inject a new Route Suitability Loading Gauge message.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all previously stored Route Suitability Loading Gauge information with the new data.

steps.action: Query the stored Route Suitability Loading Gauge data.
steps.expected: The stored data matches the new message completely, with no remnants of the old data.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Linking Information (Non-infill) from Reference Balise Group
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored linking information. A new non-infill linking message is received.
test_cases.test_inputs: New non-infill linking message with a specific reference balise group.

steps.action: Inject a new non-infill linking message with a reference balise group located within the current MA.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored linking information from the reference balise group of the new message onwards.

steps.action: Verify the linking information before the reference balise group.
steps.expected: The linking information before the reference balise group remains unchanged.

test_cases.title: Replacement of Grouped Track Condition Types
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored track condition information for 'Sound Horn' and 'Non Stopping Area'.
test_cases.test_inputs: New track condition message containing only 'Sound Horn' information.

steps.action: Inject a new track condition message containing 'Sound Horn' data with a start location.
steps.expected: The OBU replaces all stored track condition information of the listed types (including 'Non Stopping Area' if present in the group logic, or specifically the types in the new message depending on implementation interpretation of 'grouped in item g') from the start location of the first element of the new information.

steps.action: Verify the stored track condition data.
steps.expected: The 'Sound Horn' data is updated from the start location. Other types in the group are handled according to the 'replace all stored... of the listed types' rule.

test_cases.title: Resume Initial State for PBD Speed Restrictions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Speed Restriction to ensure Permitted Braking Distance (PBD) information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond a specific location.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to resume initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond location X.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for PBD speed restrictions beyond location X.

steps.action: Verify the PBD speed restriction data beyond location X.
steps.expected: The PBD speed restriction data beyond location X is set to its initial state (e.g., no restriction or default value).

test_cases.title: Resume Initial State for Axle Load Speed Profiles
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Axle Load Speed Profile information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Trackside request to resume initial state for axle load speed profiles beyond a specific location.

steps.action: Send a trackside request to resume initial state for axle load speed profiles beyond location Y.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for axle load speed profiles beyond location Y.

steps.action: Verify the axle load speed profile data beyond location Y.
steps.expected: The axle load speed profile data beyond location Y is set to its initial state.

test_cases.title: Resume Initial State for Grouped Track Conditions via Single Request
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored track condition information for 'Sound Horn' and 'Tunnel Stopping Area'.
test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial state for the listed track condition types beyond a specific location.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to resume initial state for the group of track condition types (e.g., sound horn, non stopping area, etc.) beyond location Z.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for all track condition types in the specified group beyond location Z.

steps.action: Verify the track condition data for the group beyond location Z.
steps.expected: All track condition types in the group beyond location Z are set to their initial states.

test_cases.title: Resume Initial State for Route Suitability Data
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Route Suitability information (e.g., Loading Gauge, Traction System).
test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored route suitability information.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored route suitability information.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for all route suitability data.

steps.action: Verify the route suitability data.
steps.expected: All route suitability data is set to its initial state.

test_cases.title: Resume Initial State for Station Platform Track Conditions
test_cases.preconditions: OBU has stored Station Platform track condition information.
test_cases.test_inputs: Single trackside request to resume initial state for Station Platform track conditions.

steps.action: Send a single trackside request to resume initial state for all stored track condition information of the type Station Platform.
steps.expected: The OBU resumes the initial state for Station Platform track conditions.

steps.action: Verify the Station Platform track condition data.
steps.expected: The Station Platform track condition data is set to its initial state.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with Same Orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Train orientation is Forward. Stored location based information exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction Forward.

steps.action: Receive a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation where the validity direction is the same as the current train orientation (Forward).
steps.expected: The OBU applies the normal replacement rules of §3.7.3.1. The stored location based information is updated according to the new MA and associated data, not deleted.

steps.action: Verify the stored location based information.
steps.expected: The location based information is consistent with the new MA and the replacement rules, retaining valid data where applicable.

test_cases.title: Supervised Manoeuvre with Opposite Orientation
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Full Supervision mode. Train orientation is Forward. Stored location based information exists.
test_cases.test_inputs: Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation with validity direction Reverse.

steps.action: Receive a Supervised Manoeuvre authorisation where the validity direction is opposite to the current train orientation (Reverse).
steps.expected: The OBU does not apply the normal replacement rules. Instead, it deletes all previously stored location based information.

steps.action: Verify the stored location based information.
steps.expected: All previously stored location based information is deleted. The OBU is in a state ready to receive new data for the reverse direction.

test_cases.title: MA request includes single applicable reason
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with the RBC is established. No MA request reasons are currently active.
test_cases.test_inputs: Driver selects 'Start'.

steps.action: Driver selects 'Start' on the DMI.
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC. The Q_MARQSTREASON field in the request contains the bit for 'Start selected by driver' (xxxx1) and no other reason bits are set.

test_cases.title: MA request includes multiple applicable reasons
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session with the RBC is established. The 'Start' reason is currently active (driver selected Start previously and no MA received).
test_cases.test_inputs: Trigger a track description deletion event (e.g., via RBC command or internal logic simulation) that is not in the excluded list (a, b, f, k).
test_cases.assumptions: The track description deletion event triggers an MA request immediately or resets the cycle such that a new request is sent while 'Start' is still active.

steps.action: Simulate a track description deletion event that requires an MA request.
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC. The Q_MARQSTREASON field contains both the bit for 'Start selected by driver' (xxxx1) and the bit for 'Track description deleted' (x1xxx).

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by perturbation location criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters are received from RBC. A perturbation location is defined. The train is moving towards the perturbation location.
test_cases.test_inputs: Train speed and position such that the train front passes the calculated trigger location d_MAR.
test_cases.assumptions: The trigger location d_MAR is calculated as d_perturbation - (V_MRSP + dV_warning(V_MRSP)) * T_MAR.

steps.action: Move the train such that its front end passes the location d_MAR.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC. The reason 'Time before reaching the perturbation location reached' (xxx1x) is included in the request.

test_cases.title: MA request triggered by Section timer criterion
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. MA request parameters are received from RBC. A Section timer is active for a section within the current MA.
test_cases.test_inputs: Time progression such that the defined time before the Section timer expiration is reached.
test_cases.assumptions: The RBC has defined a specific time offset T for triggering the MA request before the Section timer expires.

steps.action: Advance the system time until the moment (Section Timer Expiration Time - T) is reached.
steps.expected: An MA request is triggered and sent to the RBC. The reason 'Time before a section timer/LOA speed timer expires reached' (xx1xx) is included in the request.

test_cases.title: MA request on track description deletion (valid situation)
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is in Level 2. A communication session is established. Track description is stored on-board.
test_cases.test_inputs: A track description deletion event corresponding to a situation in Appendix A.3.4 that is NOT a, b, f, or k (e.g., situation c, d, e, g, h, i, j, l, m, n, o, p, q, r, s, t, u, v, w, x, y, z).
test_cases.assumptions: The specific deletion situation is simulated or triggered via RBC message.

steps.action: Trigger a track description deletion event for a valid situation (not a, b, f, k).
steps.expected: An MA request is sent to the RBC. The reason 'Track description deleted' (x1xxx) is included in the request.

test_cases.title: MA shortening when SvL is far but replaces LOA

steps.action: Inspect the stored location-based information listed in Appendix A.3.4.
steps.expected: Location-based information beyond the new SvL is deleted. Information between the new SvL and the previous LOA end is retained if it is within the new MA scope, but the transition from LOA to SvL triggers the shortening logic for data beyond the new SvL.

test_cases.preconditions: OBU, geçerli bir MA'ya sahiptir. RBC ile iletişim kurulmuştur.
test_cases.test_inputs: RBC'den gelen MA kısaltma isteği: Önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın ISL'si, trenin tahmini ön ucu ile aynı konumdadır.
test_cases.assumptions: Trenin tahmini ön ucu, önerilen kısaltılmış MA'nın İndication supervision limit (ISL) değerinin tam olarak üzerinde veya arkasında kabul edilir (gereksinim 'in rear' der, ancak sınır durumunda genellikle kabul edilir veya spesifik bir eşik vardır; burada 'in rear' ifadesi ISL'nin arkasında kalmayı gerektirir. Eğer tren ucu ISL ile aynı ise, 'in rear' değildir. Ancak pratikte ISL bir güvenlik sınırıdır. Gereksinim metni: 'If it is in rear... accept'. 'If it is in advance... reject'. Aynı konumda ise belirsizdir. Genellikle ISL, frenleme başlangıç noktasıdır. Tren ucu ISL'de ise frenleme başlamalıdır. Kısaltma kabul edilirse, yeni ISL eski ISL'den daha yakındır. Eğer yeni ISL tren ucunun arkasındaysa kabul edilir. Eğer tren ucu yeni ISL'nin önündeyse reddedilir. Aynı konumda ise, 'in rear' değildir. Bu nedenle reddedilmesi beklenir veya sınır testi olarak kabul edilebilir. Burada 'in rear' ifadesi katı bir 'strictly behind' olarak yorumlanırsa, aynı konum reddedilir. Ancak çoğu ERTMS uygulamasında ISL, trenin o noktaya gelmeden önce frenleme yapması gereken noktadır. Eğer tren zaten o noktadaysa, kısaltma kabul edilemez çünkü tren zaten sınıra ulaşmıştır. test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions for Emergency Brake PBD
test_cases.preconditions: OBU is configured with known train parameters and national values. Trackside sends PBD data specifying Emergency Brake.
test_cases.test_inputs: PBD data: Distance=1000m, Brake=Emergency, Gradient=0%. Train parameters: Mass, Brake characteristics, National values for T41, T_traction, T_berem, etc.
test_cases.assumptions: The OBU provides access to internal calculation logs or allows verification of the EBD curve parameters.

steps.action: Transmit PBD data for Emergency Brake with a known gradient and distance.
steps.expected: OBU initiates calculation.

steps.action: Verify that the gradient used in the calculation is compensated for rotating mass as per §3.13.4.3.
steps.expected: The effective gradient used in the deceleration calculation matches the rotating-mass-compensated value.

steps.action: Verify that the safe deceleration (A_safe) is computed without considering trackside adhesion profiles, brake inhibition, or powerless section conditions.
steps.expected: The A_safe curve used is based solely on the standard safe deceleration model, ignoring the specified trackside conditions.

steps.action: Verify that the EBD curve is calculated to reach zero speed exactly at the permitted braking distance (d_PBD).
steps.expected: The EBD curve intersects the zero-speed line at the distance d_PBD from the reference point.

steps.action: Verify that the estimated acceleration is set to zero in the calculation.
steps.expected: The calculation model uses zero acceleration for the traction phase.

steps.action: Verify that speed inaccuracy compensation (V_delta0PBD) is calculated using f41(V_PBD + dV_EBI(V_PBD)) and not inhibited by National Value (assuming NV allows it).
steps.expected: The V_delta0PBD value in the calculation matches the formula result.

steps.action: Verify that the processing delay T41 and the distance offset d_offset are calculated as per §3.11.11.4.
steps.expected: The d_offset value used in the inequality check matches L_antenna-front + T41 * (V_PBD + dV_EBI + V_delta0PBD).

steps.action: Verify that T_bs1, T_bs2, and T_traction are defined as if service brake feedback and traction cut-off were not implemented, regardless of actual configuration.
steps.expected: The time constants used in the calculation match the 'not implemented' definitions from §3.13.9.3.3 and §3.13.9.3.2.

test_cases.title: Verification of calculation assumptions for Service Brake PBD

test_cases.test_inputs: PBD data: Distance=1000m, Brake=Service, Gradient=0%. Train parameters: Mass, Brake characteristics, National values.

steps.action: Verify that an EBD curve is calculated to reach zero speed at d_PBD.
steps.expected: The EBD curve intersects the zero-speed line at d_PBD.

steps.action: Verify that an SBD curve is calculated to reach zero speed at d_PBD.

steps.action: Verify that the estimated acceleration is set to zero.

steps.expected: The V_delta0PBD value matches the formula result for service brake.

steps.action: Verify that T_bs1, T_bs2, and T_traction are defined as if service brake feedback and traction cut-off were not implemented.
steps.expected: The time constants used match the 'not implemented' definitions.

test_cases.test_inputs: Position of estimated front end relative to the end of the tunnel stopping area (Point E) and the Permitted supervision limit.
test_cases.assumptions: The train is within the range where the tunnel stopping area information is active.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is before the end of the tunnel stopping area (Point E) and the display condition remains valid.
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area' information continues to be displayed.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end passes the end of the tunnel stopping area (Point E) or the condition for display is no longer met (e.g., front end advances past Permitted supervision limit).
steps.expected: The 'Tunnel stopping area' information is no longer displayed.

test_cases.title: Sound horn area end indication based on estimated front end
test_cases.preconditions: The 'Sound horn' indication is currently displayed. The train is moving through the sound horn area.
test_cases.test_inputs: Position of estimated front end relative to the end of the sound horn area (Point E).
test_cases.assumptions: The train is within the sound horn area.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end is before the end of the sound horn area (Point E).
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication continues to be displayed.

steps.action: Move the train such that the estimated front end reaches or passes the end of the sound horn area (Point E).
steps.expected: The 'Sound horn' indication is no longer displayed.
